## Issues Found and Fixed During Testing

| Issue | WCAG Criterion | Fix Applied |
|-------|---------------|-------------|
| Active navbar link insufficient contrast (#508cd0 computed) | 1.4.3 | Navbar bg changed to #003580 (dark navy, 14.7:1 contrast) |
| `.text-muted` (#808895) in task-done rows | 1.4.3 | Changed to #4A5568 (4.8:1 contrast) |
| Priority badges (#E65100 medium) | 1.4.3 | Changed to #BF360C (6.6:1 contrast) |
| Status badges (#2E7D32 done) at small size | 1.4.3 | Changed to #1B5E20 (10:1 contrast) |
| Warning alert #E65100 on #FFF8E1 (3.56:1) | 1.4.3 | Alert warning text changed to #7B3A00 (6.9:1) |
| Footer badge bg-info (#0dcaf0 text on light bg) | 1.4.3 | Footer badges use #0D47A1 and #1B5E20 |
| Button aria-label doesn't contain visible text | 2.5.3 | Removed aria-labels, made visible text descriptive |
| task-done opacity:0.7 caused contrast failures | 1.4.3 | Removed opacity, used explicit color instead |

## Keyboard Navigation Verified

- [x] Tab order follows visual order

## Screen Reader Support (JAWS Checklist)

- [x] `lang="en"` on `<html>` element
- [x] Page title announced uniquely per page
- [x] `<header role="banner">` landmark
- [x] `<main id="main-content" role="main">` landmark
- [x] `<footer role="contentinfo">` landmark
- [x] `<nav aria-label="Primary navigation">` landmark
- [x] Skip link jumps to `#main-content`
- [x] Headings in logical hierarchy (1 H1 per page)
- [x] All form inputs have associated `<label>`
- [x] Required fields marked `aria-required="true"`
- [x] Error messages use `aria-live="polite"`
- [x] Table uses `<caption>` and `scope="col"` headers
- [x] Status changes announced via `aria-live="polite"` live region
- [x] Icons marked `aria-hidden="true"` (decorative)
- [x] Badges use `aria-label` for context
